name: Campfire Kitchen
tagline: Camp meals planned, packed and cooked over fire
about: Campfire Kitchen plans meals for a whole trip around your stove and cooler, packs the cooler so food stays safe for days, and turns out foil packets, Dutch-oven bakes and no-cook lunches at the pitch.
persona: You are a seasoned campsite cook: practical about coolers and ice, strict on food and fire safety, and inventive with a single pot and a roll of foil.

onboarding.title: Eat well outdoors
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Campfire Kitchen what you cook on and how you keep things cold.
bullets: Trip meal plans with a packing list
Cooler packing that keeps food safe

tools.title: Plan the trip
tools.subtitle: Every meal, one packing list

inputs.label: Notes
inputs.placeholder: arrive Friday evening, big hike Saturday

tools.prompt: Plan meals for {nights} nights and {people} people on the profile's stove and cold storage, notes: {notes}. Table (Day | Breakfast | Lunch | Dinner | Cooler-safe on that day?), a checklist of food to pack ordered by when it's eaten (most perishable first) followed by a checklist of kit (pans, foil, lighter, wash bowl), and a callout on which meals to prep at home.

tools.title: Pack the cooler
tools.subtitle: Keep it cold and safe

inputs.label: What's going in
inputs.placeholder: sausages, milk, cheese, eggs, salad, beer

tools.prompt: Pack {food} in the profile's cold storage for {days} days: steps for packing order (ice or blocks, raw meat lowest and sealed, dairy, then drinks), a table (Item | Eat by day | Where in the cooler | Sign it's gone off), and a callout on the danger zone, freezing items to use as ice, and never trusting food that got warm.

tools.title: Foil packet dinner
tools.subtitle: Build it, seal it, bury it in embers
tools.prompt: A foil-packet dinner of {protein} and {veg} on {heat} for the profile's group: kv (packet size, layers in order, minutes, flip at), steps for building a leak-proof packet, bullets on checking it's cooked (juices clear, potatoes pierce), and a callout on burns, tongs and letting steam escape away from your face.

tools.title: No-fire meals
tools.subtitle: Wet day, fire ban or just lazy
tools.prompt: 3 no-cook {meal} ideas from {have} for the profile's group as cards (meta = minutes · kid-friendly?), a checklist for assembling it in a tent porch, and bullets on keeping opened tins and dairy safe without heat.

tools.title: Dutch-oven bake
tools.subtitle: Bread, cobbler or a stew for the whole pitch
tools.prompt: A Dutch-oven {what} for a {size}-litre pot on the profile's fire setup: kv (coals on top / underneath, target temp, minutes, rotate every), a checklist of ingredients, steps for the method, and a callout on handling a hot lid, wind, and putting the fire out properly.

disclaimer: Follow site fire rules and local wildlife guidance; food-safety timings are general — when in doubt, throw it out.
